sentence: This project builds a robot with several sensors that looks inside the abdominal cavity to find abnormal tissues.
This project studies how water flow and microbes that use methane without oxygen affect how much methane from wetlands reaches the atmosphere.
This project uses quantum computers to simulate how molecules move and react.
This project tests a way to help deep technology startups find international partners.
This project uses artificial intelligence to find tables in data files so scientists can use past climate data more easily.
This project makes a plan for a testbed where people can build quantum tools to protect the power grid from cyberattack.
This project offers a course of study and research in cybersecurity, including network security and cryptography.
This project designs and builds optical neural networks made from metasurfaces that recognize images using light.
This project builds a shared data system to help researchers recover rare earth elements from end-of-life electronics.
This project uses nets, sound and ocean models to find out what changes how many mesopelagic animals live in the California Current.
This project uses quantum computing to train machine learning models quickly to detect seizures and read digital pathology images.
This project studies how DNA sequencing, especially nanopore sequencing, can be used for research in undergraduate courses.
This project builds an artificial intelligence model that measures redshift and other properties of galaxies from their light spectra.
This project sets up a computer system built to make deep learning training much faster for scientists.
This project studies how heat moves through topological matter and tries to learn more about unusual particles called anyons.
This project describes the genomes of species that are not well studied and tries to find out what recently found genes do.
This project builds a framework that automatically finds and fixes leaks of secret information in software for cryptography algorithms.
